genre_style_dimensions: authorial stance, argumentative structure and disciplinary register
genre_translation_style: Preserve conceptual distinctions and the source's logical scope, modality, quantifiers, negation and degree of certainty. Distinguish the author's claims from quotations, reported views, hypotheses, examples and objections; translate quotations faithfully with their attribution intact. Keep numeric values, units, mathematical notation, citation keys, bibliographic identifiers and cross-reference labels intact. Use precise, readable $tgt_label academic prose without embellishment or simplifying the argument. Do not add explanations, invent or repair citations, or correct the author's claims using outside knowledge; retain source ambiguities and inconsistencies.
genre_analysis_focus: disciplinary register, conceptual distinctions, authorial stance, argument structure and citation practices relevant to translation
genre_tone_description: Disciplinary register, authorial stance and degree of formality
genre_analysis_structure_fields:
"narration": "Authorial voice, attribution of positions, stance and tense",

genre_digest_focus: Cover the chapter's central questions, key concepts, claims, reasoning, evidence and conclusions, including qualifications or disagreements that affect interpretation. Mention methods and findings only when present. Omit minor details. Write concise analytical prose
genre_synopsis_focus: Help translators understand the work's subject, disciplinary context, central questions, conceptual framework and progression of the argument. Relate the main claims to their evidence, objections and conclusions, retaining important qualifications and unresolved disputes. Describe methods and findings only when present. Do not impose an experimental-paper structure on theoretical, historical or interpretive works, or turn tentative claims into established facts.
genre_glossary_concepts: discipline-specific concepts, theories, methods, measures and classifications
genre_fixed_expression_examples: recurring technical expressions, methodological labels, named principles and standardized formulations
genre_synthesis_style: natural word order and precise expression of the source's logical relations and disciplinary register
genre_revision_style: authorial stance, logical scope, terminology, citation attribution and disciplinary register
genre_voice_focus: the author's stance, attribution and degree of certainty
